art_direction.scene: A fictional adult repeats one easy foot transition on a low wall, gently moving a shoe between two broad neighboring footholds while both hands stay on generous grips. An oversized step-down hold sits immediately nearby, and the short sparse wall section avoids any exhausting endurance circuit. Use original linocut-inspired illustration with sweeping curved marks, flat cream highlights, and forest green, mustard, and vermilion planes. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels. Climbing stays low above continuous thick mats, with immediate step-down.
